Game Overview

Outer Space puts players into a adventure experience centered on navigate the cosmos as a fearless astronaut in Outer Space. Blast asteroids, dodge lethal hazards, and harness crystal particles. With vibrant graphics and thrilling strategic challenges, every level presents unique obstacles, rewarding skillful maneuvers and strategic play as you aim for the ultimate score.
